records.rationale: The SWE-bench evaluation harness applies candidate patches via git apply, applies dedicated hidden test patches, executes repository test commands, and parses test outcome logs (FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS assertions) to determine resolution. Test assertions are evaluated in clean environments, requiring all FAIL_TO_PASS tests to pass and all PASS_TO_PASS tests to remain passing.
records.detection_limits: Grader execution checks verify syntax and execution exit codes, but cannot detect specification-oracle gaps where test suites test implementation details rather than functional requirements, nor do they prevent models from guessing hard-coded values if tests are overly narrow.
records.audit_execution: Automated harness inspection verifying that grader applies patches cleanly, executes pytest/django test runners, and evaluates binary PASS/FAIL assertions without permissive bypasses.
records.method_adequacy: Adequate: Execution-based evaluation comparing pre-patch and post-patch test outcomes under separate FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS test specifications.
records.empirical_finding: Test grading executes via automated test frameworks; patch evaluation fails when target assertions fail and passes only when both target and regression tests succeed.
records.warrant: Discharges Functional Measurement, ensuring candidate resolutions are scored based on actual test suite outcomes rather than synthetic heuristics.

records.detection_limits: While item-level binary outcomes enable calculating standard confidence intervals, they do not account for intra-repository issue correlation or clustering, which may lead Wilson intervals to slightly underestimate true sampling variance.

records.evidence_location: SWE-bench paper (Jimenez et al., 2024, ICLR 2024) Section 4.2; SWE-bench Verified dataset card (2024); OpenAI evaluation methodology report (2024)
records.rationale: SWE-bench Verified enforces a temporal cutoff (pull requests created before January 2024) and documents that candidate models may have observed public GitHub repositories in pre-training data. OpenAI and Princeton conducted canary checks and n-gram overlap analyses for specific foundation models, but third-party closed models (e.g. Gemini, Sol/GPT) have undisclosed training corpora, preventing third parties from auditing pre-training exposure directly.
records.detection_limits: Third-party evaluators cannot verify the absence of pre-training exposure in closed commercial models without training data disclosures or model provider cooperation. Temporal cutoff alone does not prevent web scraping of GitHub issues prior to model cutoff dates.
records.audit_execution: Review of documented contamination methodology and temporal cutoff timestamps across the 350 candidate repository tasks.
records.method_adequacy: Partially adequate: Temporal cutoff is verified in commit metadata, but empirical pre-training n-gram auditing on closed commercial weights remains inaccessible to independent evaluators.
records.empirical_finding: Task creation dates are documented (2018-2023), confirming release predates January 2024, but proprietary training set exposure remains unverified. Rated Documented (unresolved per decision table for proprietary weights without canary audits).
records.warrant: Fails to fully discharge Contamination Neutrality for closed proprietary models without explicit canary disclosures, rendering C14 an active gatekeeper that appropriately yields Unresolved under conservative policy.

records.evidence_location: SWE-bench evaluation harness (swebench/harness/docker_build.py, docker_run.py), containerized environment specifications
records.rationale: The official SWE-bench evaluation harness builds dedicated Docker container images per repository and version, creating a clean container instance for each task evaluation and discarding container state upon task completion, preventing inter-task file leakage or persistent state.
records.detection_limits: Docker container isolation guarantees clean filesystem states between tasks, but relies on proper container daemon configuration and does not prevent network calls unless explicitly run with --network none.
records.audit_execution: Inspection of Dockerfile templates and container execution scripts verifying that each task attempt executes in an ephemeral container with worktree reset.
records.method_adequacy: Adequate: Per-task ephemeral Docker containers provide strong process and filesystem isolation.
records.empirical_finding: Evaluation harness creates isolated container instances per task evaluation with automated teardown upon completion.
records.warrant: Discharges Execution Independence by verifying that benchmark runs evaluate each task in an isolated runtime environment.
